name: IC Power Switching Regulator — 3.3V, buck — QFN
description: Cluster of surface-mount 3.3V buck switching regulator ICs using QFN-16-1EP and VQFN-16-1EP footprints.
selection_hints: Select between tier A (PAM2305BJE330) and tier B (TPS62132, TPS62142, TPS62152) quality options.
Match layout requirements for QFN-16 or VQFN-16 3x3mm footprints with exposed pads.
Verify thermal via requirement specified by VQFN-16-1EP footprint variants.
avoid_when: The design requires a voltage output other than 3.3V.
The circuit needs a non-buck regulator topology.
The PCB layout requires non-SMD or non-QFN package footprints.
